signal: Tutor Intelligence closed a $34M Series A led by Union Square Ventures in December 2025 to scale its AI-powered warehouse robot fleet

email.body1:
Lenard, saw Tutor Intelligence closed its $34M Series A to scale the warehouse robot fleet.

Scaling a RaaS motion that fast usually means more in-market manufacturers than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Tutor off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lenard, quick follow-up for Tutor.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Tutor needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lenard, last bit of proof for Tutor.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Tutor's reply rate likely compares to other robotics startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lenard, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-deployment stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a robotics RaaS motion? I will tailor it to Tutor either way.
